title: Skeleton in Blue Suit
description: A skeleton wearing a blue suit, vest, and fedora stands on a pile of broken bricks holding two briefcases. The skeleton's skull rests on the bricks in the foreground while a wooden barrel and crate sit nearby under a large dead tree against a big orange sun.
prompt: A skeleton dressed in a blue suit with vest and black fedora hat stands on broken brick rubble holding two brown briefcases in its bony hands, a human skull sits on the bricks in front of it, a wooden barrel and wooden crate are on the ground nearby, a large leafless gnarled tree rises behind it with a huge bright orange sun in the background, the scene sits on a rocky base with scattered stones, painted in realistic digital art style with earthy tones.
